headline: Argentina Defends Free Trade and Criticizes Environmental Barriers at G20
summary: Argentine Minister Pablo Quirno defended free trade and criticized environmental barriers during the G20 meeting of foreign ministers.
why: G20 ministerial meetings shape international trade policies and diplomatic stances on global economic cooperation.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Stances at international forums reflect government trade policy directions.
